items.title: Applied Optoelectronics Receives First Volume Order for 800G Data Center Optics

paragraphs.text: Applied Optoelectronics today announced that it has received its first volume order for 800G optical modules from a leading hyperscale customer.
Deliveries under the order are scheduled to begin in the fourth quarter.
